note: No earth-science group in the atlas; group left OTHER. The edge to the existing 'unit-circle' node is a real link: a parallel's length scales with cos of latitude.

description.zh: 纬度和经度是球面上的两个角度，合起来定位任意一点；纬线周长随 cos 纬度缩小，球面摊成平面必然变形，最短路是大圆弧，15° 经度对应 1 小时。仅为球形地球的教学模型。
description.en: Latitude and longitude are two angles on a sphere that together locate any point; a parallel’s length shrinks with cos latitude, flattening a sphere necessarily distorts, the shortest route is a great-circle arc, and 15° of longitude is one hour. A teaching model of a spherical Earth.

label.zh: 纬线长度 ∝ cos 纬度

reason.zh: 纬度 φ 处的纬线圈半径是 R·cos φ，这正是单位圆上的 cos，所以 1° 经度对应的距离随纬度按 cos φ 缩小。
reason.en: The parallel at latitude φ has radius R·cos φ, the same cosine as on the unit circle, so the distance for 1° of longitude shrinks like cos φ with latitude.

title.zh: 为什么世界地图上高纬度的地方显得特别大？
title.en: Why do high-latitude regions look so big on a world map?

ask.zh: 纬线周长随 cos 纬度缩小——赤道和北纬 60° 的纬线圈，哪个长？长几倍？
ask.en: A parallel's length shrinks with cos(latitude) — which is longer, the equator or the 60° N parallel, and by what factor?

ask.zh: 把地球想成单位圆上的角度：经度差 15° 对应几小时？为什么球面摊成平面必然变形？
ask.en: Think of the Earth in terms of angles on a circle — how many hours does 15° of longitude correspond to? And why must flattening a sphere distort it?

reveal.zh: 高纬纬线圈短得多，但地图常把它们拉长，所以显得特别大；15° 经度对应 1 小时，球面无法不经变形摊平。
reveal.en: High-latitude parallels are much shorter, but maps stretch them, so they look huge; 15° of longitude is 1 hour, and a sphere cannot be flattened without distortion.
